title: Lift Tile
summary: A product tile that rises a few pixels on hover or keyboard focus.
useWhen: product grid for a premium hardware brand
catalogue tiles that should feel tactile

whyItWorks.how: The tile moves 6px in 180ms, small enough to see fifty times a session.
A strong ease-out curve makes the tile respond at once and settle gently.
The lift is bound to :hover and :focus-visible in the same rule.

directions.name: Editorial
directions.change: Swap the lift for a slow underline wipe and drop the shadow.

directions.name: Playful
directions.change: Add a two degree rotation and raise --lift to 10px.

pitfalls: Raising the duration past 300ms makes dense grids feel sticky.
reducedMotion: The tile stays still and keeps its normal appearance.
